subject: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU Pool MAP & Evaluation Plan (Finexa)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU Pool MAP & Evaluation Plan (Finexa)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time last week. As discussed on the call, this thread will be our Mutual Action Plan (MAP) kickoff for the Dedicated GPU pool engagement and the short evaluation cadence so we can lock in a closing timeline. I’ve attached a draft MAP and a capacity worksheet to get the ball rolling.

High-level goals we heard from you:
- Achieve 99th percentile p99 latency < 350ms at typical prompt lengths (~512 tokens) for the customer-facing inference endpoint.
- Support sustained throughput of ~90 rps during peak windows with room to burst to 140 rps for 10–15 minute periods.
- Data isolation via a dedicated pool with audit logging and SOC2-aligned controls.

Proposed MAP milestones (dates are suggestions — please flag conflicts):
1) Week 0 (this week) — MAP kickoff and roles confirmed (owner: Rachel).
2) Week 1 — Capacity & workload survey completed by Finexa; Redwood returns GPU pool sizing + cost estimates (owner: Marissa).
3) Week 2 — Test plan and sample prompts for eval run; environment access provided (owner: Monica + Finexa infra).
4) Week 3 — Live evaluation on dedicated pool (throughput, p99, quality checks).
5) Week 4 — Review results, finalize SLOs, and agree on committed tier + contract terms.

Immediate asks from Finexa: two short items we need by EOD Friday:
- A prioritized list of representative prompt families and 3 peak windows (times in your local timezone).
- Network / VPC contact to provision access for the evaluation pool.

Please reply with any updates to the milestone dates and confirm who will be the primary technical owner on Finexa’s side.

Attachments: Finexa_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP with roles & timeline), finexa_capacity_estimates_v1.xlsx (blank worksheet for Finexa to fill).

Thanks — looking forward to working through this together.

—
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference, unified across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finexa.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU Pool MAP & Evaluation Plan (Finexa)

Rachel —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick responses inline and a couple of clarifications: 

- We can confirm a primary technical owner: Priya Rao (CC’d).
- Prompt families: we’ll provide the prioritized list by Thursday EOD; main classes are claims triage, patient Q&A, and clinical summarization.
- Peak windows: 9:00–10:30 PT and 16:00–17:00 PT weekdays (higher throughput).

About the throughput numbers: 90 rps sustained is ambitious but aligns with our expected volumes for next quarter. We’d like the evaluation run to include a 30-minute soak at ~100 rps and two 10-minute bursts at 140 rps to validate autoscaling / queueing behavior. Does Redwood support automated burst scaling into a higher reserved burst pool for the eval?

Also, can you confirm whether audit logs for the dedicated pool can be exported to our S3 bucket for retention? Security will want that verified prior to the evaluation.

Appreciate the quick turn. Priya will drop the prompt list and the infra contact.

—Alex
VP, Product — Finexa Health
alex.johnson@finexa.com | +1 212-555-8421
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU Pool MAP & Evaluation Plan (Finexa)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the notes — we can absolutely include the soak and burst profile in the evaluation. Quick answers to your two asks: 

- Burst scaling: yes, Redwood can provision a temporary burst configuration for the eval that brings additional reserved VMs into the dedicated pool for short windows. We’ll need the exact burst schedule and an approved cost cap for the evaluation to enable it.
- Audit logs: we can export audit logs (access, inference events metadata, config changes) to your S3. We’ll share the required IAM role and bucket policy you should create.

Next steps from our side by Friday EOD:
- Marissa: initial pool sizing + estimated monthly cost for the proposed profile.
- Monica: evaluation runbook + scripts and a short checklist for the Finexa infra team.
- Rachel: finalize MAP dates based on Priya’s prompt list.

If useful, we can schedule a 30-minute tech alignment call tomorrow to walk Priya through the eval runbook and S3 setup.

Thanks,
Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finexa.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexa.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated GPU Pool MAP & Evaluation Plan (Finexa)

Thanks — quick confirmation from our side: 

- I’ll own the prompt families and will upload the prioritized list to the Drive link by EOD today (included examples and expected success criteria per prompt).
- Infra contact: Jordan Patel (jordan.patel@finexa.com) — he can take the S3/IAM setup work.
- Burst schedule: we’ll plan for a 30-minute soak at 100 rps on 2026-10-14 09:00–09:30 PT, and two 10-minute bursts at 140 rps on the same day at 09:55–10:05 PT and 16:05–16:15 PT. Please include any throttling/fallback behavior in the runbook so our product team can validate graceful degradation.

We’re aiming to close procurement by 2026-11-05 if the evaluation meets the targets — happy to align on checkpoints to make that date viable.

I’ll post the prompt list and sample dataset to the Drive link now.

—Priya
Senior Engineering Manager — Finexa Health
---- End of thread ----
